author: Ash

copy.intro: You've picked out a Mariemur bra, then reached the size options: XS to 2XL, with no band or cup to choose. If you know your exact bra size, that's a problem. These brands sell sheer, lace-heavy bras to the US in band-and-cup sizes, starting with the one closest to Mariemur's prices and ending with the splurge.

bodies.aubade:
Aubade is the closest swap if you like Mariemur's sheer pieces but want a bra sized by band and cup. The Sheer Emotion Half cup ($139) is the one to start with. It's an underwired bra with see-through moulded tulle cups, priced inside Mariemur's $89 to $169 range.

Aubade is a Paris lingerie house that launched in 1958, and its US store runs bands 30 to 42 and cups A to H. Need a G cup? The Sweetessence Spacer plunge bra ($139) goes that far. Shipping and returns are free in the US with no minimum, so a single bra doesn't pick up the $12.90 Mariemur charges below $350.

The catch is time. You get 30 days to send something back, against Mariemur's 45. And the harness pieces here are chain and cord, not leather.
bodies.la-perla:
La Perla is the bra to save up for. It began as Ada Masotti's corsetry atelier in Bologna in 1954. Even its cheapest bra, the Plunge Bra Romantica ($365) in Leavers lace and sheer tulle, costs more than twice Mariemur's priciest.

If you want something sculptural, start with Pure Black. The Plunge Bra Pure Black ($390) is built from Italian stretch silk satin soutache. Sizes use Italian numbers, 1 to 5 with cups A to E, which line up with UK bands 32 to 40. Duties are already in the price.

Shipping costs $25 unless you spend $680, and returns close after 30 days. If you want a bigger cup range or a smaller bill, Aubade covers both.

best_for.aubade: a 32G or 40C with Mariemur's sheer look
best_for.la-perla: one silk or Leavers lace bra worth saving for

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: Start with how you buy bras. If letter sizes work for you, Mariemur's XS to 2XL is the simplest route, and its leather harnesses have no match here. If you shop by band and cup, Aubade covers 30 to 42 and A to H for $119 to $439, with free US shipping both ways. La Perla is for one standout piece. Its bras run $365 to $820, cups stop at E, and you'll pay $25 shipping below $680. So for most budgets, Aubade is the first stop and La Perla the occasional treat.

faqs.a: Mariemur sells its own label from mariemur.com in US dollars and ships US orders from a US warehouse. Bras and bodysuits can go back within 45 days with a free US return label, but panties and latex can't be returned.

US orders ship from Mariemur's US warehouse, usually the next business day, and returns go to Middletown, Pennsylvania. Standard US delivery costs $12.90 and takes 3 to 6 business days, or it's free over $350.
Mariemur is a lingerie label known for strappy sets, leather harnesses and bodysuits, made with lace and Italian leather. Its bras cost $89 to $169 and come in XS to 2XL.
